title: Machine Learning Toolkit: Importing NumPy, Matplotlib, and Pandas Libraries

cues.en: -: And now we're gonna tackle very quickly the very first step of this toolkit which is the libraries.
cues.zh: 現在快速處理這個工具箱的第一步，也就是函式庫。

cues.en: How to import the libraries.
cues.zh: 如何匯入函式庫。

cues.en: How to have them ready anytime we start building a new machinery model.
cues.zh: 以及每次建立新模型時，如何讓它們準備好供我們使用。

cues.en: Well, there We go, I will show you this right away.
cues.zh: 我馬上示範。

cues.en: It's actually very simple.
cues.zh: 其實非常簡單。

cues.en: We're gonna import three libraries now, which are NumPy, matplotlib, and pandas.
cues.zh: 現在要匯入三個函式庫：NumPy、Matplotlib 和 pandas。

cues.en: NumPy will allow us to work with arrays because indeed you will see that your future machinery models will expect some arrays as input, and therefore, we need the library
cues.zh: NumPy 讓我們處理陣列，因為之後的機器學習模型通常會要求陣列作為輸入，所以需要

cues.en: to work with these arrays, and that's NumPy.
cues.zh: 用 NumPy 來操作這些陣列。

cues.en: Then we'll import matplotlib, which is the library that will allow us to plot some very nice charts.
cues.zh: 接著匯入 Matplotlib，這個函式庫可以畫出漂亮的圖表。

cues.en: You will see that we will plot actually many charts and graphs in this course.
cues.zh: 課程中會畫很多圖表。

cues.en: And finally, pandas, which Will allow us to not only import the dataset, but also create the matrix of features and the dependent variable vector.
cues.zh: 最後是 pandas，不只可以匯入資料集，還能建立特徵矩陣與依變數向量。

cues.en: I will explain of course, all these concepts later.
cues.zh: 這些概念稍後都會說明。

cues.en: All right, so let's import these libraries.
cues.zh: 現在開始匯入。

cues.en: In order to import the library in Python, it's very simple.
cues.zh: 在 Python 中匯入函式庫非常簡單。

cues.en: You start With import.
cues.zh: 先寫 import。

cues.en: That's just a command that will allow to import a library, or even a function or any type of modules.
cues.zh: 這個指令可以匯入函式庫，甚至函式或各種模組。

cues.en: By the way, a library is a symbol of modules containing functions and classes with which you can perform some actions and operations.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，函式庫是由多個模組組成，裡面有函式和類別，可以執行不同操作。

cues.en: For example, the most well-known library in data science is scikit-learn and this is the library that contains actually all the machinery models that you can build
cues.zh: 例如資料科學中最有名的 scikit-learn，就包含各種機器學習模型，

cues.en: by simply creating an object of some classes.
cues.zh: 只要建立相應類別的物件，就能使用。

cues.en: So, don't worry about all this now.
cues.zh: 現在先不必擔心這些概念。

cues.en: We will see that in great detail each time we build machinery models.
cues.zh: 每次建立模型時，我們都會仔細說明。

cues.en: But there you go, you will see that libraries will be super useful for us in order to build our machinery models.
cues.zh: 你會發現，函式庫對建立機器學習模型非常有幫助。

cues.en: So there We go. Import.
cues.zh: 所以，先寫 import。

cues.en: Then you need to follow by the name of the library you want to import.
cues.zh: 再接上想匯入的函式庫名稱。

cues.en: And the first one we want to import is called NumPy.
cues.zh: 第一個要匯入的叫做 numpy。

cues.en: And then what we usually do is we add a shortcut because each time we will use a function of the NumPy library, well, we'll have to call first NumPy.
cues.zh: 通常我們還會替它設定簡稱，因為每次使用 NumPy 的函式，都得先寫出 NumPy。

cues.en: And in order to call it faster, well we can add a shortcut here, so that each time we want to call NumPy, Will actually call it with its shortcut.
cues.zh: 為了呼叫得更快，可以在這裡加上簡稱，以後就用這個簡稱來呼叫。

cues.en: And the shortcut we usually use for NumPy is NP, and as you can see, to add a shortcut, you simply need to add "S" and then the shortcut name.
cues.zh: NumPy 常用的簡稱是 np，只要加上 as，再寫簡稱即可。

cues.en: All right, so each time we will call NumPy, we will actually call NP.
cues.zh: 所以，以後呼叫 NumPy 時，就寫 np。

cues.en: Then, next library import.
cues.zh: 接著匯入下一個函式庫。

cues.en: So that next library is matplotlib, and actually, as I told you, a library is an ensemble of modules.
cues.zh: 下一個是 Matplotlib，如前所述，函式庫是由多個模組組成的。

cues.en: And here we're interested in a particular module called Pyplot, and that's the module that allows us to plot very nice charts.
cues.zh: 這裡要用的特定模組叫 pyplot，專門用來畫圖。

cues.en: And so here we're not only going to import matplotlib, but particularly, well, the Pyplot module.
cues.zh: 因此，不只是匯入 matplotlib，而是特別匯入 pyplot 模組。

cues.en: And as you can see, in order to get this Pyplot module, I added a dot here, which allows indeed to access the different modules of the matplotlib library.
cues.zh: 可以看到，要取得 pyplot，就在這裡加上句點，存取 Matplotlib 中的模組。

cues.en: And the module we chose is Pyplot.
cues.zh: 我們選擇的模組是 pyplot。

cues.en: And again, we're gonna add a little shortcut here, Which we're gonna call PLT.
cues.zh: 一樣替它設定簡稱，叫做 plt。

cues.en: That's the usual name for this Pyplot module.
cues.zh: 這是 pyplot 模組慣用的簡稱。

cues.en: All right, and finally, we're gonna import a final library which is the pandas library, a super useful library to pre-process your dataset and mostly to import them.
cues.zh: 最後，匯入 pandas，它對資料前處理，尤其是匯入資料，非常實用。

cues.en: And same for this library, we're gonna add the simple shortcut name, PT.
cues.zh: 同樣替它設定簡單的名稱 pd。

cues.en: And there you go. Congratulations.
cues.zh: 完成了，恭喜。

cues.en: Now, not only you know how to import the libraries but mostly you have your very first data pre-processing tool in your toolkit.
cues.zh: 你現在不只知道怎麼匯入函式庫，也在工具箱中放進了第一個資料前處理工具。

cues.en: So now, we're gonna move on to the second tool, which will be to import the dataset.
cues.zh: 接著要進入第二項工具：匯入資料集。

cues.en: And that's exactly what we'll do in the next tutorial.
cues.zh: 這就是下一堂課要做的事。
